lesson.title: Gib ihr bitte das Paket

sentences.text: Der Zusteller hat mir ein Paket und eine Nachricht für Frau Klein gebracht.
sentences.natural_meaning: The delivery person brought me a parcel and a message for Ms Klein.

verb_help.usage: The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
gebracht is the past participle of bringen; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.

sentences.text: Ich habe unterschrieben und die Lieferung angenommen; der Zusteller hat das Paket bei mir abgegeben.
sentences.natural_meaning: I signed for it and accepted the delivery; the delivery person left the parcel with me.

sentences.text: Geben Sie ihr bitte das Paket und die Nachricht heute Abend weiter.
sentences.natural_meaning: Please pass the parcel and the message on to her this evening.

sentences.text: Ja, ich erreiche sie nach der Arbeit.
sentences.natural_meaning: Yes, I will reach her after work.

sentences.natural_meaning: If she is not home, I will give her husband the parcel and the message so that he can pass both on to her later.

lesson.initial_question: Who passes the parcel and message to Frau Klein if she is not home?
lesson.topic: accepting and passing on a parcel

performance_activity.instruction: Use the picture-card cues to say who hands each item to whom and relay the delivery message aloud.
prompts: Picture card 1: a delivery person holding a parcel and a sealed note at an apartment door
Picture card 2: a neighbor signing for both items while Frau Klein is away
Picture card 3: Frau Klein arriving home; picture card 4: her husband holding the parcel and note
Relay item A (parcel) and item B (note) from the sender through the temporary receiver to Frau Klein; say: Die Lieferung ist angekommen.
